name: vruum
description: Connect your Vruum workspace to review revenue priorities, manage deals, research prospects, and prepare outreach through guided skills and authenticated MCP tools.

interface.longDescription: Connect your existing Vruum workspace to review daily priorities, inspect deals, research people and companies, and prepare outreach. Use guided workflows to review drafts and record updates in your workspace. Access follows your Vruum account permissions, and execution follows your workspace policies.
defaultPrompt: What needs my attention in Vruum today?
Review my stalled deals and recommend the next action for each.
Review my outreach drafts and suggest improvements before I approve them.
